title: Boléro: Ravel and Fricsay
question: How does the same accumulating rhythm occupy different amounts of time?
intro: Ravel directs the Lamoureux orchestra in the transfer attributed to 1930; BnF confirms the performer combination and a published Polydor issue by 1935. Fricsay’s reference file has conflicting1950s dates, so no exact session year is asserted for it. The access streams last about15:52 and 13:26 respectively, including their recorded leads and tails; the alignment follows shared musical position rather than multiplying every moment by one ratio. Tzipine and the unverified Munch/Lamoureux alternatives are not included.

recordings.note: The composer conducts; the transferred historic recording was published by 1935. Listen to the distribution of time through the accumulation.
